rows.note: Use 隔離 as the all-purpose choice for putting people or things apart, including quarantine and self-isolation.

example.english: The doctor told me to isolate at home and not go anywhere.
example.traditional: 醫生叫我留喺屋企隔離，唔好周圍去。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 giu3 ngo5 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 gaak3 lei4 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 heoi3

rows.note: Use 分離 when separating a substance or a pure strain from a mixture.

example.english: The researcher used this method to isolate the bacterial strain from the mixed culture.
example.traditional: 研究員用呢個方法，將菌種由混合培養液入面分離出嚟。
example.jyutping: jin4 gau3 jyun4 jung6 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 zoeng1 kwan2 zung2 jau4 wan6 hap6 pui4 joeng5 jik6 jap6 min6 fan1 lei4 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use 隔絕 when cutting something off from outside influence rather than separating it physically from a group.

example.english: This room uses special materials to isolate it from outside noise.
example.traditional: 呢間房用咗特別物料，隔絕外面嘅噪音。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong4 jung6 zo2 dak6 bit6 mat6 liu2 gaak3 zyut3 ngoi6 min6 ge3 cou3 jam1
